source: ElNet, MODBUS & BACNET Communication with ELNET PowerMeters, last update 6.7.2022
notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485 (8 data bits, even or no parity, 1 stop bit, set in the meter setup); some models (GR, PQ, LT TCP, MC) also speak Modbus TCP. Addresses 1 to 255; the manual gives a default address of 31. The manual does not give a default baud rate.

Every parameter is a 32-bit IEEE float in two registers. Function 04 returns the full float; function 03 returns only the integer part. Since 1 November 2018 a function 04 read at the register number plus 30000 returns a 32-bit integer instead (not mapped here).

Registers are listed as printed in the manual, where "1-2" is the pair holding the first parameter; they are taken to be numbered from 1, so the map uses address base 1 and the first register of each pair (the manual does not say whether the printed number is the wire address). Items that are R/W in the manual appear twice: once as a read-only input register (function 04, full float) and once as a holding register for writing.
The word order of the float is not stated for the default setting; the manual only offers a Float Order register (567-568, 0 = LM, 1 = ML) on GR and PQ. High word first is assumed.

The manual marks, with check marks, which of GR, PQ, PICO, VIP-P, LT, LT-color, LT (TCP), MC, LTE and LTC has each parameter; that availability is not carried over, so some registers may not exist on a given model. Units are set only where the manual gives them in the description or the item is plainly a voltage or current.

Clock registers (151-157 in the item numbering, registers 301-314) are written only after writing the special value 123 to register 99 of the item list, as described in the manual; the magic value is not modelled. Multi-channel units (MC2, MC8, MC12) answer on one consecutive Modbus address per channel starting at a configured base address.

Seven rows of the manual print a malformed register range (8806-08, 8846-48, 8886-88, 8926-28, 8966-68, 9006-08 for the L2 current alarm items and 10682-84 for Voltage Line 3 (15 Minute Average)); they are read as the pair that ends at the printed number (8807, 8847, 8887, 8927, 8967, 9007 and 10683), following the L1 row before each. One unnamed row (7591-92) is left out.
Test Value 12.34 and Fix Value (Debug) 123.4 are fixed values that the manual lists, kept as reference values.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
